    c.email_address,
    c.town_city,
    c.county
FROM Customers c
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT c2.customer_id
    FROM Customers c2
    WHERE c2.gender_code IN (
        SELECT gender_code
        FROM (
            SELECT gender_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM Customers
            GROUP BY gender_code
        )
        ORDER BY cnt ASC
    )
    LIMIT 1
)
